title: Real-time output contract validation and pinning workflow for onboarding models
creator: Ayesha Patel
description:
Goal: Create a reproducible validation and pinning workflow that certifies newly onboarded models for streaming and external tool/function-calling compatibility, and publishes a verified performance profile into the model catalog. This ticket covers test definitions, automation harness additions, gating policy for version pinning, and the publish artifact format for performance profiles.

Background: We have intermittent failures across streaming/func-call use cases when onboarding models with new attention kernels, quantization, or altered tokenization. Customers require that when they pin a model version we guarantee consistent streaming semantics (chunk boundaries, partial JSON assembly, function call invocation events) and that the published performance profile accurately reflects latency/throughput observed under our serving runtime.

Outcomes expected by the due date:
1) A conformance test suite that runs against model artifacts and returns a pass/fail with detailed failure categories.
2) A model gating policy document (pinning checklist) used by onboarding engineers that must be satisfied before a model is allowed to be pinned for production tenants.
3) Automated publication of a performance profile JSON to the model catalog (P50/P95 latency, tokens/sec, memory, preferred quantization, recommended batching config).

Non-goals: Upgrading runtime kernels or model re-training. This is verification and publishing only.
acceptance_criteria: Conformance suite returns < 2% false-negative rate over historical set of 12 previously certified models
Streaming semantics: chunked events preserve order and do not split JSON tokens across boundary more than 0.1% of responses under fuzz tests
Function/tool calling: invocation lifecycle (tool_request -> tool_response -> function_call complete) matches our protocol for 100 canonical tool schemas
Latency measurements: end-to-end P95 for 32-token continuation within +/-10% of the published profile under load profile C (20 concurrent connections) in the canary environment
Model pin gating: onboarding checklist items marked green for 100% of models pinned during the trial window
Performance profile schema produced and uploaded to model catalog for each passing model
test_plan: Unit: Add parser fuzz tests to streaming marshaller to exercise boundary byte/utf-8 tokenization and ensure deterministic reassembly

Integration: Run conformance suite in canary cluster against model artifact; tests include synthetic tool endpoint (echo + delayed responses) and a webhook-based external tool to validate backpressure and retry semantics
System: Run 2-hour soak with production-like traffic mix (chat, long completion, embeddings) to capture memory growth and KV cache behavior
Regression: Run previously failing model snapshots through the suite to verify fixes; record diffs in the conformance report
Performance: Measure P50/P95 latency, tokens/sec, GPU mem, and tail latencies under three sequence length buckets (16, 128, 1024) and publish into profile JSON
automation_tasks: Extend existing harness (tests/runtime/conformance) with a streaming verifier that can assert event-level invariants and emit structured failure tags
Add function-call schema runner using 100 canonical tool definitions (including nested JSON, streaming-tool results, and tool timeouts)
Hook the conformance result into model-registry pipeline so a failed run blocks pin creation and opens a remediation checklist ticket
Create a CI job (models/conformance:nightly) that runs a smoke conformance job on newly added model artifacts and posts results to Slack #model-onboarding
Implement automated performance profile generator and uploader (S3 -> model-catalog) with signed artifact and checksum
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): Run conformance + publish profile for 3 new models in canary; require manual review of reports by MLOps
Phase 2 (trial): Open pin gating to internal alpha tenants, monitor errors and fidelity metrics for 7 days
Phase 3 (GA): Enforce gating in the pin API; any pin requests for models without a passing conformance profile will be rejected with guidance
Fallback: If a pinned model later regresses in production, automatically create rollback ticket and require re-certification before re-pinning
risks: False positives from fuzz tests could block acceptable models — mitigate by running historical baseline and adjusting thresholds
Performance profile variance across hardware families may confuse customers; include hardware tags and a clear best-effort notice in the profile
Edge-case tokenization differences across tokenizers could cause function-call JSON fragmentation; add tokenizer-sync step to onboarding checklist
Automated gating could create operational bottlenecks if conformance runs are slow — need parallelism and caching of warm KV states
